testInfo.description: OID4VP wallet conformance test for SIROS wallet
testInfo.summary: Sends a DCQL query with two credential entries wrapped in credential_sets: the real credential and a second non-matching credential, both required. The wallet cannot satisfy the whole query, so it must not return a vp_token — in particular it must not return an empty vp_token object, nor a partial vp_token containing only the real credential. The wallet should return an 'access_denied' error response, or reject the request and display an error, a screenshot of which must be uploaded. The DCQL configuration must not already contain credential_sets.
